evidence.label: VentureDex product record
evidence.source: content/startups/aegisai.json summary, editor_note, funding, and research fields

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 1
evidence.source: The official product page says AegisAI connects through Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 APIs, needs no MX-record change, and can begin in monitoring mode.

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 2
evidence.source: The product page exposes automated triage, agent summaries, indicators of compromise, recommended actions, dashboards, and executive reporting rather than only a phishing classifier.

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 3
evidence.source: The official site publishes named customer evidence from Mesh, Lokker, LangChain, and other security teams describing deployed threat detection and dashboard workflows.

risks: Research risk candidate: The falsifiable product risk is whether AegisAI's reported reductions in false positives and added attack detection reproduce across independent evaluations and a wider enterprise customer base.
Research risk candidate: AegisAI's homepage currently labels the Series A as $49M, while the company-supplied funding announcement says the round was $36M and total funding reached $49M.

evidence.label: VentureDex product record
evidence.source: content/startups/paper.json summary, editor_note, funding, and research fields

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 1
evidence.source: The official site presents a live design canvas built on HTML and CSS, with workflows for syncing tokens, styles, components, content, and production code.

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 2
evidence.source: Paper's MCP documentation shows that agents can read and write design files through Paper Desktop and gives concrete connection instructions for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, and OpenCode.

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 3
evidence.source: The homepage exposes separate Web, Desktop, MCP, Snapshot, and Shaders product surfaces rather than a single design-demo landing page.

risks: Research risk candidate: The falsifiable product risk is whether Paper's desktop-local MCP workflow can support permissions, concurrency, auditability, and design-system governance for larger teams.
Research risk candidate: The funding announcement names Accel and ICONIQ but does not designate a formal lead; Accel is recorded as the representative lead because it is the first investor named.

evidence.label: VentureDex product record
evidence.source: content/startups/cashboard.json summary, editor_note, funding, and research fields

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 1
evidence.source: Cashboard presents a financial semantic layer that keeps live source data, mapping logic, metric definitions, report definitions, and access permissions in one governed system exposed through MCP.

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 2
evidence.source: The official site says Cashboard connects more than 900 ERP, CRM, HRIS, warehouse, and spreadsheet sources and uses an approval workflow to keep new data labels from silently changing mappings.

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 3
evidence.source: Cashboard shows outputs moving into Claude, ChatGPT, Slack, Gmail, and Excel while row- and system-level permissions travel with the underlying data.

risks: Research risk candidate: The falsifiable risk is whether Cashboard can maintain more than 900 integrations and company-specific semantic models without onboarding and ongoing services becoming the dominant product cost.

evidence.label: VentureDex product record
evidence.source: content/startups/cascade.json summary, editor_note, funding, and research fields

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 1
evidence.source: The official site says Cascade scans 41,206 active U.S. projects, grades each opportunity for firm fit, and can show a first match within five minutes without an integration.

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 2
evidence.source: Cascade says it predicts projects months before an RFP by connecting new funding, bond filings, city minutes, and prior award signals, then maps which contacts are likely to have work coming.

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 3
evidence.source: TechCrunch describes the workflow as onboarding a firm's profile, ranking projects it can win, and predicting upcoming work across state, local, private, and federal sources.

risks: Research risk candidate: The falsifiable product risk is whether Cascade can keep private and public project signals fresh enough to produce measurable bid wins rather than more leads for teams to review.
Research risk candidate: The funding source does not name a formal lead; Andreessen Horowitz is recorded as the representative lead because Andreessen Horowitz Speedrun is the first investor named.

evidence.label: VentureDex product record
evidence.source: content/startups/uniti.json summary, editor_note, funding, and research fields

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 1
evidence.source: The official site exposes eight agent categories spanning sales and leasing, support, maintenance, collections, reviews, renewals, data analysis, and payments.

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 2
evidence.source: Uniti says its agents work across voice, email, SMS, WhatsApp, and web chat, read from and write to existing PMS and CRM systems, and let operators configure workflows, tone, rules, and escalation paths.

evidence.label: Structured product evidence 3
evidence.source: The homepage lists integrations with more than 15 property-management and CRM platforms and reports that StorQuest uses Uniti to resolve 70% of inbound calls.

risks: Research risk candidate: The falsifiable risk is whether one configurable agent layer can handle emergency maintenance, collections, payments, and tenant-sensitive edge cases consistently across different property types and jurisdictions.
